note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(应对压力主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: Before her first violin concert, Nina felt so nervous that her hands shook and her mouth went dry. Instead of panicking, she found a quiet corner, breathed slowly for a few minutes, and told herself that a little stress was perfectly normal. By the time she walked onto the stage, she felt calm enough to enjoy every note.

questions.q: What did Nina do instead of panicking?
options: She calmed herself by breathing slowly in a quiet spot.
She refused to go on stage at all.
She shouted loudly at the audience.
She gave her violin to a friend.
questions.explanation: 原文'found a quiet corner, breathed slowly … told herself a little stress was normal'的转述。

questions.q: How did Nina feel by the time she went on stage?
questions.explanation: 末句'felt calm enough to enjoy every note'的转述(短文结尾,覆盖不同位置)。
